conflict_resolutions.RELATIONAL_LEADS_WITHOUT_TARGET_STATUS_O: RELATIONAL_LEADS_WITHOUT_TARGET_STATUS_OBSERVATION and EV:LE-d53e0611028a (EO 7854 'Revokes: EO 6055'): read the actor text; the revocation is real but conditional on the filing of the resurvey plat, a fact not held. EO 7855/7856 attributions are same-page mislabels.

material_gaps: held record of the official filing of the plat of resurvey of T. 11 S., R. 70 W., 6th P.M., Colorado (the condition for EO 7854's revocation to take effect), or a BLM/GLO status record showing the withdrawal ended or still operative through 2026-10-14
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Original (Hoover vol. II, EO 6055, 1933-02-28, OCR transcription) read; identity confirmed (withdraws T. 11 S., R. 70 W. pending resurvey; 'continue in full force and effect unless and until revoked'). EO 7854 (1938-03-30) expressly revokes EO 6055 as a whole but its own text says 'This order shall become effective upon the date of the official filing of the plat of the resurvey of the said lands'. The ACT ids for EO 7856 are a mislabel of the same Federal Register page (the revocation text is EO 7854's; EO 7855 concerns a different Colorado withdrawal). Nothing held shows the plat was filed, so the effective date of the revocation is not established; the revocation is known only as conditional. A NO needs more than that (owner ruling 2026-10-28: 'whether it happened is not established' is not an interval). Lifecycle remains open.
